armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each unit from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army (see below). The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6.

Any Dread abilities that have been selected are active until the end of the battle. You cannot select the same Dread ability more than once, and any duplicated Dread abilities (as a result of randomly selecting them) have no additional effect.

### The Dread Abilities
▪ **Deathly Terror (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
▪ **1. Despair (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability.
▪ **2. Doom:** Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.
▪ **3. Darkness:** This model has [core:Stealth].
▪ **4. Dismay (Aura):** In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
▪ **5. Delirium (Aura):** While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
▪ **6. Dominion:** Add 3" to the range of this model's Aura abilities.

### Dreadblades
If every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can include either 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

### Super-heavy Walker
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
▪ It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
▪ It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

rule.body:
If a Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army has an Aura ability that affects friendly War Dog units, while two or more friendly WAR DOG models are within range of that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit’s Aura ability, that TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is affected by that Aura ability as well.

**Example:** Two friendly WAR DOG models are within 9" of a Knight Desecrator when it is selected to shoot. As a result, the KNIGHT DESECRATOR’s Taskmaster ability also affects itself, even though it does not have the WAR DOG keyword, so each time that KNIGHT DESECRATOR makes a ranged attack, Hit rolls of 1 are re-rolled.
rule.flavor: By bending their tyrannical will upon their War Dog underlings, the masters of the hunt goad them to provide a constant stream of sensor data. This influx of supplementary targeting, prey-seeking and omnisensory analysis enhances the scions’ ability to hunt alongside their snarling ironclad hounds.

enhancements.flavor: The machine spirit of this Knight suit has become so ferocious and blood-hungry that it now moves and hunts like a monstrous beast.

rule.body:
In your Command phase, one or more CHAOS KNIGHTS units from your army can make a Malefic Surge. Each one that does must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is Empowered. While a unit is Empowered it can use one of the Malefic Surge abilities below. Once that unit has used a Malefic Surge ability, it is no longer Empowered.
▪ **Unholy Hunger:** When a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, until the end of the phase, add 3" to its Move characteristic.
▪ **Diabolic Power:** When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.
▪ **Unnatural Fortitude:** When this unit is selected as the target of an attack, select one of the following to apply until the end of the phase:
▪ Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
▪ Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

**Designer’s Note:** We recommend placing a token next to Chaos Knights models that are Empowered, removing it once they have used a Malefic Surge ability, and removing all unused tokens at the start of your Command phase.
rule.flavor: Calling upon heretical - often supernatural - powers, these Knights are infused with strange and terrible might.
rule.name: Malefic Surge

stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis

stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity

In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: Daemonic whispers guide this Knights pilot through the empyric tempests, straight into battle.

enhancements.flavor: Hammered into the flesh of a Fallen Noble’s forehead and allowed to take root, this warp crystal allows them to predict their enemy’s plans and exploit them.

rule.name: Tyrannical Court

armyRule.body:
If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each unit from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army (see below). The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6.

Any Dread abilities that have been selected are active until the end of the battle. You cannot select the same Dread ability more than once, and any duplicated Dread abilities (as a result of randomly selecting them) have no additional effect.

### The Dread Abilities
▪ **Deathly Terror (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
▪ **1. Despair (Aura):** While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability.
▪ **2. Doom:** Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.
▪ **3. Darkness:** This model has [core:Stealth].
▪ **4. Dismay (Aura):** In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
▪ **5. Delirium (Aura):** While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
▪ **6. Dominion:** Add 3" to the range of this model's Aura abilities.

### Dreadblades
If every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you can include either 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

### Super-heavy Walker
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
▪ It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
▪ It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect

rule.body:
In your Command phase, one or more CHAOS KNIGHTS units from your army can make a Malefic Surge. Each one that does must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is Empowered. While a unit is Empowered it can use one of the Malefic Surge abilities below. Once that unit has used a Malefic Surge ability, it is no longer Empowered.
▪ **Unholy Hunger:** When a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, until the end of the phase, add 3" to its Move characteristic.
▪ **Diabolic Power:** When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.
▪ **Unnatural Fortitude:** When this unit is selected as the target of an attack, select one of the following to apply until the end of the phase:
▪ Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
▪ Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

**Designer’s Note:** We recommend placing a token next to Chaos Knights models that are Empowered, removing it once they have used a Malefic Surge ability, and removing all unused tokens at the start of your Command phase.
rule.flavor: Calling upon heretical - often supernatural - powers, these Knights are infused with strange and terrible might.
rule.name: Malefic Surge

stratagems.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.flavor: Some Fallen Nobles are conjoined, symbiotically or parasitically, with the hideous systems of their Chaos Knight. This allows them to channel more unholy energies, though not without risk.
stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is not Empowered.
stratagems.when: End of any phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.flavor: Reinforced with warp-infused materials and warded through ritual blood sacrifice, these Chaos Knights can withstand unnatural levels of punishment.
stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: The foul energies and unnatural influence of the Chaos Knights spread from them like sorcerous radiation, tainting all they touch.
stratagems.name: Corrupting Taint
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.flavor: Ectoplasmic blood surges hot through glowing conduits as the Fallen Noble feeds power to their Knight suit’s supernaturally enhanced ion shield emitters.
stratagems.name: Diabolic Bulwark
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.flavor: Supernatural sensors perceive the soul-spoor of their prey, or even stare forward through fate and time.
stratagems.name: Warp Vision
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.
stratagems.flavor: These weapons bathe the target in blasts of daemonic balefire that burns flesh and soul alike.
stratagems.name: Unleash Balefire
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
enhancements.flavor: Flowing from this brazen Throne, an all-consuming need for murder grips the pilot and never lets go.
enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer’s ranged weapons have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.
enhancements.flavor: Inlaid with esoteric circuitry, this relic sword is sheathed within the mechanisms of the pilot’s Throne where it imbues the Knight suit with flowing swiftness.
enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
enhancements.flavor: Daemonic whispers guide this Knights pilot through the empyric tempests, straight into battle.
enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player’s Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.
enhancements.flavor: Blessed by Nurgle, the Chaos God of plague and despair, the hide of this Knight suit is thickened with steadily regenerating layers of rust and rotting blubber.
enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a **[gloss:stratagem:Stratagem]**, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that **Stratagem** by 1CP.
enhancements.flavor: Hammered into the flesh of a Fallen Noble’s forehead and allowed to take root, this warp crystal allows them to predict their enemy’s plans and exploit them.
enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.
enhancements.flavor: This pilot has won the favour of a sinister patron, granting them a measure of mysterious protection.
enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master

rule.body: Improve the Objective Control characteristic of CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER models from your army by 2. In addition, once per battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.
rule.flavor: Every one of these egomaniacal warriors seeks to claim all the battlefield glory for themselves, at any cost.
rule.name: Tyrannical Court

stratagems.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.
stratagems.flavor: Determined that tales will be told of their spectacular end, the Fallen Noble overloads the internal generators of their Knight suit, hoping to take their enemy with them into oblivion.
stratagems.name: Spiteful Demise
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army is destroyed.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.flavor: The Chaos Knights engage in duels not for honour, but to assert their absolute dominance over the battlefield.
stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.flavor: Inscribed into the Knight suit’s servo-skeleton, these markings channel the pilot’s contempt for the foe and manifest it as a sorcerous aura of defence.
stratagems.name: Runes of Disdain
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.flavor: The Fallen Noble dedicates their latest conquest to the Dark Gods in hope of reward.
stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.when: Start of your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.flavor: Screaming enemy warriors are crushed to gory paste as the Chaos Knight tramples spitefully through their midst, stamping and raking these unworthy foes with its huge, taloned feet.
stratagems.name: Crushed Like Vermin
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army ends a Normal move.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.flavor: To these Fallen Nobles, each new foe chased down is another opportunity to claim gory trophies.
stratagems.name: Trophy Hunter
stratagems.sublabel: Lords of Dread – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army consolidates.

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.
enhancements.flavor: The mere sight of this warrior and their steed upon the battlefield, even the rumour of their coming, is enough to put the foe to flight.
enhancements.name: Nightmare’s Master

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is within range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army.
enhancements.flavor: Once this despotic warlord lays claim to territory, their warp-infused will taints the very land itself and resists those who seek to defy them.
enhancements.name: Tyrant’s Shadow

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.
enhancements.flavor: Inscribed by Idolators schooled in dark arts, these unholy blazons burn themselves into the gaze of the foe and trigger nausea, disorientation and stark, unreasoning terror.
enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.
enhancements.flavor: Said to have been fashioned upon Perturabo’s own daemon world, this baroque device projects an energy barrier of greater power than a standard ion shield.
enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard

rule.body: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting one or more Dread abilities to be active for your army, you can select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (this additional Dread ability cannot be randomly selected).
rule.flavor: Steeped in the dark powers of the warp, bred into bloodlines who make a tradition of cruelty and a virtue of malice, these merciless warriors delight in spreading fear and dismay.
rule.name: Paragons of Terror

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.flavor: Chaos Knights leave only death and devastation in their wake, and reduce entire worlds to ruin.
stratagems.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.when: Fight phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).
stratagems.flavor: Employing piloting skill or brute force, Fallen Nobles can either manoeuvre or simply barge their steeds through foes and obstacles alike.
stratagems.name: Imperious Advance
stratagems.target: Up to two War Dog units from your army or one TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.
stratagems.flavor: Fallen Nobles sneer at the pathetic efforts of their foes, doubly so in the case of those who fear them.
stratagems.name: Disdain for the Weak
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect:
▪ Your unit has [core:Stealth].
▪ Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to Hit rolls.
stratagems.flavor: Through dark rituals and dread pacts, the Chaos Knights draw upon the fear and despair of their foes and bind it into a curse upon the land itself, wreathing themselves in a shrouding pall.
stratagems.name: Storm of Darkness
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.
stratagems.flavor: The neural connections between Fallen Nobles and doggedly loyal or fearful War Dog pilots can extend over remarkable distances.
stratagems.name: A Long Leash
stratagems.target: One Abhorrent model from your army and up to two friendly War Dog units.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
stratagems.flavor: Shrieking with hunger, Pterrorshades descend in a whirlwind to feast on the fearful souls of the foe. Their banquet transmutes into vital energy that flows into the Chaos Knight on which they roost.
stratagems.name: Pterrorshades
stratagems.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.body: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. When this unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]** until this unit has shot.
enhancements.flavor: The gothic and mutated extrusions of this Knight Tyrant are the roost of a parasitic flock of pterrorshades. From their Throne, the Fallen Noble within has brokered a fragmented understanding of the maddening chorus they emit, enough to know when their unnatural senses have spotted fresh prey to be annihilated.
enhancements.name: Pterrorshade Rookery

enhancements.body: KNIGHT TYRANT model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.
enhancements.flavor: This arrogant despot has yoked their weapon spirits to their will with a dominion forged of pure hate. Every maximised salvo is an expression of their malice and tyranny.
enhancements.name: Hate-filled Dominion

rule.body: Friendly KNIGHT TYRANT units’ attacks that target a **[gloss:battle-shocked:Battle-shocked]** unit have +1 to the Hit roll.
rule.flavor: The withering arsenal of cursed weaponry available to a Knight Tyrant is turned with the cruellest focus upon those its scion despises for their weakness of spirit.
rule.name: Annihilate the Unworthy

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
stratagems.flavor: The mightiest of the Chaos Knights are etched with malign wards capable of shielding them from powerful weapons and throwing back esoteric assaults.
stratagems.name: Rune-cursed Stronghold
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wound]**.

stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
stratagems.flavor: Eager to unleash the full power at their fingertips, the scion of a Knight Tyrant will allow nothing to impede their devastating arsenal.
stratagems.name: Pitiless Focus
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit is selected to make a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall-back move]**.

stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is **[gloss:sm-suppressed:suppressed]** until the start of your next Command phase: while a unit is **suppressed**, that unit’s attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.
stratagems.flavor: With a spiteful lash of suppressive firepower, a Knight Tyrant reminds its foes of the deferent fear and awe that are the only acceptable attitudes in the presence of such power.
stratagems.name: Intimidating Reminder
stratagems.target: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot.

enhancements.body: HUNTSMAN unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.
enhancements.flavor: Those Huntsmen darkly blessed with a daemonic device sensitive to a worthy prey’s spirits are capable of killing shots at greater effective ranges.
enhancements.name: Soul-spoor Auspicator

enhancements.body: EXECUTIONER unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
enhancements.flavor: The greatest Executioners are expert long-range killers. They viciously compete for tallies of slaughter and eagerly eviscerate dug-in foes to prove their skill.
enhancements.name: Snarling Rivalry

rule.body: (Once per battle round, per army) In your Shooting phase, you can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of a friendly WAR DOG unit. That enemy unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
rule.flavor: The corrupted pilots of War Dog suits despise fear and cowardice in the foe almost as much as they revel in hunting such prey and betraying their hiding places.
rule.name: Scenting Fear

stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Feel No Pain 5+].
stratagems.flavor: Gripped by a fever to kill and with prey within reach, whatever damage the prey inflicts is smothered by a War Dog’s thrill of the hunt.
stratagems.name: Insensate Bloodthirst
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit.

stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an Action]**.
stratagems.flavor: Under the painful neural leash of a Helm Mechanicum, a War Dog pilot’s gory instincts can be overridden to undertake vital operations prioritised by their larger masters.
stratagems.name: Leash of the Masters
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WAR DOG unit has shot.

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.flavor: With a prize under their talons, War Dogs are adept at evading the prey’s sight by loping low through cover.
stratagems.name: Stalking Focus
stratagems.target: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**.

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when that unit is selected to make a normal/advance/fall-back move, that unit has +2" M until the end of the phase.
enhancements.flavor: This callous Fallen Noble drives teeming hordes of their twisted serfs at a desperate pace to overwhelm their prey with lesser targets.
enhancements.name: Cruel Lashmaster

enhancements.body: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when you target that unit with the **[gloss:heroic-intervention:Heroic Intervention Stratagem]**, that use is -1 CP.
enhancements.flavor: Chanting mortal thralls have pledged their lives and souls to this Chaos Knight’s defence, and throw themselves at any who dare threaten the object of their idolatry.
enhancements.name: Iconoclast Idol

rule.body:
▪ You can include DAMNED units in your army (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines). The combined points cost of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
▪ Friendly DAMNED units can re-roll **[gloss:leadership-roll:Leadership rolls]**.
rule.flavor: Devoted mortal thralls flock to fight in the titanic shadow of their mechanical idols with chanted prayers and brayed challenges.
rule.name: Wretched Thralls

stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. Friendly DAMNED units’ attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].
stratagems.flavor: As the object of their adulation is consumed by fire, mortal worshippers are roused to a desperate fury, seeking vengeance on behalf of their deceased master.
stratagems.name: Avenge the Masters!
stratagems.target: That enemy unit.
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is **[gloss:destroyed:destroyed]** by an enemy unit.

stratagems.effect:
Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3:
▪ Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.
▪ That CHAOS KNIGHTS model **[gloss:heal:heals]** that number of wounds.
stratagems.flavor: The pilots of corrupted Knight suits demand a ritual offering of their serfs, and their mechanical steed feeds upon the victims’ life forces and raw fear.
stratagems.name: Dark Sacrifice
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.

stratagems.effect: Select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted: while a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" **[gloss:detection-range:detection range]**.
stratagems.flavor: With blaring hunting horns and bellowed calls to their towering masters, mortal thralls signal the location of hiding prey.
stratagems.name: Coursing Thralls
stratagems.target: One friendly DAMNED unit.
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase.
